name: journal-of-physical-education
description: Use when targeting 《体育学刊》(Journal of Physical Education) — a CSSCI sport-science journal (South China Normal University) with a strong profile in school physical education and sport humanities & social science (mass sport, sport policy, sport sociology), alongside general sport science. Best for school-PE reform, youth fitness/health promotion, and theory-engaged sport social science; route lab exercise science and applied competitive work to the exercise-science / 中国体育科技 venues.
